name: Dwarf Star's Glow deals 2 damage to target unit
notes: Dwarf Star's Glow is an ASTRA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ASTRA champion (Arisanna, Astral Zenith) to unlock element access. Targets the opponent's champion directly for a straightforward damage assertion. The Starcalling alternate-cost clause and the 'if starcalled, put into memory' clause are tied to the separate glimpse subsystem and are out of scope (this fixture pays the normal reserve cost).
